For all 23 prediction cells (44 parts), the (stat, rule, delta) of each part equals the prereg predictions[] entry, delta is design_constants.equiv_delta_b (0.05) for equiv_abs_le and intercept_delta_P (2) for diff_abs_gt, and my own implementation of the four part rules and of compound() reproduces each printed part verdict and each prediction verdict from point and ci95 (table below).

D2.evidence: Recomputed verdicts == main's printed run.stdout == verdicts in data/results/g2b/g2b_score.json == verdicts in my re-run == the claim in the brief: cv295: E1 PASS, E2 PASS, O1 PASS, O2 PASS, P1 PASS, P2 INCONCLUSIVE, P3b INCONCLUSIVE, P4 INCONCLUSIVE; uv231: E1 PASS, E2 PASS, O1 PASS, O2 PASS, P1 PASS, P2 INCONCLUSIVE, P3a INCONCLUSIVE, P3b FAIL, P4 INCONCLUSIVE; xm600: E1 PASS, E2 PASS, O1 PASS, P1 PASS, P3b FAIL, P4 INCONCLUSIVE.

D3.evidence: Kill rules recomputed from my verdicts, rmse_P and excluded_runs: K1 False (P1 FAIL on 0 of 3 datasets, threshold 2), K2 False (needs P2 FAIL on both; P2: cv295 INCONCLUSIVE, uv231 INCONCLUSIVE), K3 False (largest rmse_P over every Section 5 variant of the primary lexicon: cv295 0.502, uv231 0.318, xm600 0.642; limit 3), KN1 False (E1: cv295 PASS, uv231 PASS, xm600 PASS), KD False (excluded_runs {}); KL applied. Printed kill_rules equal my values (run.stdout prints KL as null because the KL record has no 'fires' key; it carries applied: true). Clean-subset sizes re-derived by me with the pinned guards (looks_vietnamese, CJK_RE) equal the output: LADDER 263/295 cv295, 209/231 uv231, 537/600 xm600.

D4.evidence: Prediction points for E1, E2, O1, P1, O2 equal the per-gold slope/b table of the same output (max abs diff 0.0); the sensitivity_full_set blocks carry no verdict; the secondary-lexicon (uv231) verdicts also recompute.

verdict_rules.sign_gt_0: PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.sign_lt_0: PASS if ci95_hi < 0; FAIL if point >= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.equiv_abs_le: PASS if -delta <= ci95_lo and ci95_hi <= delta; FAIL if ci95_hi < -delta or ci95_lo > delta; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.diff_abs_gt: PASS if ci95_lo > delta or ci95_hi < -delta; FAIL if -delta <= ci95_lo and ci95_hi <= delta; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.compound: FAIL if any part is FAIL; else NOT_EVALUABLE if any part is NOT_EVALUABLE; else PASS if every part is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.not_evaluable: NOT_EVALUABLE if the analysis set is empty or a statistic is undefined (a system with M_x = 0, or fewer than 2 distinct M_x in a family)
verdict_rules.counting: Kill rules count FAIL only. INCONCLUSIVE is reported as inconclusive and never as support. Earlier preregistrations scored sign and ordering claims on point estimates; 'not FAIL' here is that criterion, so the outcomes can be compared.

kill_rules.K1: G2B-P1 is FAIL on 2 or more of the 3 datasets (uv231 counts; primary lexicon)
kill_rules.K2: G2B-P2 is FAIL on both cv295 and uv231. G2's K2 counts backbones (2 or more of 3); here one backbone has English outputs, so K2 cannot be evaluated as written
kill_rules.K3: rmse[g](LADDER) > 3 precision points (point estimate) for a gold variant g of a dataset (Section 5 variants, primary lexicon)
kill_rules.KN1: G2B-E1 is FAIL (one-reference slope >= 0) on any dataset (uv231 counts)
kill_rules.KL: always applied: verdicts are computed on clean subsets only
kill_rules.KD: a run whose provenance shows a model file, prompt, decoding setting (Section 3), pinned package version or pinned instrument different from this registration

rows.overall_reason: Inputs are the 23 registered decodes, byte-equal to their sources and sidecars, with CC-027 provenance correct in all 23; code, prereg and map are tracked and equal HEAD; my single re-run differs from main's output only in created_utc (canonical JSON equal, no remaining difference); every part, prediction and kill-rule verdict recomputes from the statistics and equals the printed ones.

primary.statistic: Q = theta * Range_F1 - Range_cF1; Range = max - min over the three gold levels of the OLS slope of 100 * measure on ln M over LADDER (score_g2b.stat_slope)

notes: The brief names manuscript/AGENT_RULES.md; that path does not exist. I read manuscript/paperA_plan/AGENT_RULES.md (untracked in git).

Only created_utc differs between main's outputs and my re-runs; it is written from the WSL clock, which is behind the host clock (main's g2b_score.json has a D: drive mtime at least 8.8 s after the end of the run on the WSL clock). No statistic reads a clock.

Wording in the committed addendum: its does_not_change field says the confirmation map stays byte-identical, but the same commit 80852f4 adds amendment_2 to the map (additive A-N1 outcome sentences, as CC-032b condition 3 and PD-18 allow; no G2-B rule or sentence changed). The addendum json status still reads DRAFT; the registration rests on the commit and CC-032b.

By registration xm600 has no O2, P2 or P3a verdicts, and G2B-NS has none (not predicted); run.stdout therefore lists fewer cells for xm600. KL appears as null in run.stdout because its record has no 'fires' key (it carries applied: true).

Scope: my re-runs use the same code, inputs and environment as main's, so they show determinism (output reproduced up to created_utc) plus an independent recomputation of the verdict, kill-rule and outcome layer and of the clean-subset sizes. The statistic code itself (slopes, b, residuals, bootstrap) is not re-derived here; it rests on the registered self-check (52/52 cells). Also not re-done: the decode runs and any claim in Paper A text.
